name: medley
description: [DEV CHANNEL] Missions inside Codex: give /mission a goal and Medley plans the work, then supervises execution until the goal is met — bringing you in for the higher-level decisions and reviews that actually need you, not routine approvals. Work is distributed across models and runtimes you configure. Steer any time from the chat or a live dashboard; everything stays on your machine except model calls.

interface.shortDescription: Plan a mission, supervise parallel workers.
interface.longDescription: Medley turns a complex goal into a DAG of tasks, routes each to the right model and runtime, and supervises the workers that execute them in your repo — while you stay in the chat. Dev channel: prerelease engine builds, expect breakage.
defaultPrompt: $medley:mission add tests and docs for this module
